model.source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best (official repository; downloaded once with the owner's approval, then vendored)
model.selection_rule: lowest mean character error rate on the degraded G-INDIC pages, ties broken by clean pages; size must fit the base-install budget

rejected.reason: higher error rate on clean and degraded pages in the recorded bake-off

routing.detector: tesseract OSD (osd.traineddata) on a 1200 px thumbnail
routing.ambiguous: run the English path; when its page quality warns, also run hin+eng and keep the result with the higher mean engine confidence; both are recorded

proposed_by_agent.basis: the bake-off on the rendered G-INDIC pages (clean about 0.006, degraded about 0.002) with headroom for real scans, which will be worse; the owner freezes the real value (S4.indic.ocr_cer_max, Q-S4-04), ideally after measuring on real scans
